title: Report On Whereabouts Of Otto Kruger

page_data.en:
D.819.
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Foreign Section. Station.
June 25, 1939.
REPORT ON Whereabouts of Otto Kruger
Made by Temp. Cler. Ass't J. A. Cook varded by Thos Robertson, C.D.I.

A German bearing the name of Otto Kruger arrived
in Shanghai quite recently and has been recognized by some of
his former acquaintances.
He formerly resided here in 1927 and had a foundry
in Chapei near to the Russian church.
He left Shanghai for Canton shortly after the
disturbance here in 1927.
Kruger served in the German Army as aviator
and was taken prisoner by the Russians in the Great War at
Strugat (?) on the Eastern front.
He was employed by the Bolshevist Air Government
as aviator and flew over Pootung, Chapei, etc. in a seaplane,
from which he, together with the Russian mechanic Kerglitsky,
threw propaganda leaflets before the disturbance in 1927.
He is stated to be residing with an employee of
the Electric Station, named McPhee, in Muirhead Road close to
the Wayside Police Station, near a Chinese printing establishment.
*00.9207

John F. Cox
T. C. A.

AR.
25/6/39
C.I.D. Reg.
Please draft a letter to
Singapore and despatch copy to
British Consulate.
N/D. C. I.

D.819.
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
外侨股。巡捕房。
1939年6月25日。
关于奥托·克鲁格（Otto Kruger）行踪的报告
由临时文员助理 J. A. Cook 制作，经刑事侦缉探员 Thos Robertson 转呈。

一名名为奥托·克鲁格的德国人最近抵达上海，并被其一些旧识认出。
他此前曾于1927年在此居住，并在闸北俄国教堂附近拥有一家铸造厂。
在1927年本地骚乱发生后不久，他离开上海前往广州。
克鲁格曾在德军服役，担任飞行员，并在第一次世界大战期间于东线斯特鲁加特（Strugat，原文如此）被俄军俘虏。
他曾被布尔什维克航空政府雇佣为飞行员，驾驶水上飞机飞越浦东、闸北等地，在1927年骚乱之前，他与俄国机械师 Kerglitsky 一起从飞机上投撒宣传传单。
据称，他目前与一名名为 McPhee 的发电厂雇员同住，住址位于麦特赫司脱路（Muirhead Road），靠近路边巡捕房及一家中文印刷所。
*00.9207

John F. Cox
总华捕助理

AR.
1939年6月25日
刑事侦缉处登记。
请起草一封致新加坡的信函，并将副本发送至英国领事馆。
副刑事侦缉处长。

SECRET.

POLICE JOURNAL, STRAITS SETTLEMENTS.

Paragraphs 164 to 170.

No. 11 of 1929). Singapore, 15th November, 1929. (Distribution No. 40.

Foreigners and Suspects.

167. Kruger, Otto. (Para. 95 of 1929).
The C.I.D. Burm , reports that Kruger alias Ahuleizer, alias
Koenig, alias Kleine Neuman, recently visited India and professed
to be a Hindu. He said that he had studied Indian politics and
would speak out through the German newspapers when he reached Ger-
many. His talk was anti-British.
He is reported to be interested in the M.O.P.R. and the Inter-
national Youth Movement and has in his possession credentials from
Munzenberg (one of the General Secretaries of the League against
Imperialism) and Tan Shen Chi, the representative of the Chinese
communist party in Germany. The object of his visit to the East
is to obtain Indian and Chinese delegates for the anti-Imperialist
Youth Conference in Europe.

外侨与嫌疑分子。

167. 克鲁格，奥托。（1929年第95段）。
缅甸刑事侦缉处报告称，克鲁格，又名 Ahuleizer，又名 Koenig，又名 Kleine Neuman，最近访问了印度，并自称是印度教徒。他说他研究过印度政治，并表示到达德国后将通过德国报纸发表言论。他的言论具有反英性质。
据报道，他对国际革命战士救济会（M.O.P.R.）和国际青年运动感兴趣，并且持有明岑贝格（Munzenberg，反帝国主义同盟总书记之一）和谭申池（Tan Shen Chi，音译，中国共产党驻德国代表）签发的证件。他访问东方的目的是为在欧洲举行的反帝国主义青年大会争取印度和中国代表。

（批注：请通知法国警察（副本） 12月28日）
（批注：刑事侦缉处 R.1 1929年12月23日）

I.O. 9039

Sir,
OTTO KRUGER.
With reference to Para. 79 of the Straits
Settlements Police Journal, May 15, 1929, enquiries
show that the person named Otto Kruger arrived in
Shanghai recently and is now residing at No.109
Rue Chapsal, French Concession.
The activities in Shanghai of Kruger who is
reported to have served in the Great War affords
reason for suspicion that he has pro-Bolshevik
sympathies.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Acting Director of Criminal Investigation.

Inspector-General of Police,
Straits Settlements,
Singapore.

C. Y. Lu.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Foreign Section Station,
REPORT
Date August 26, 19 29
Subject (in full) Otto Kruger.
Made by P.S. Medvedeff. Forwarded by Jno Robertson C.D.I.
Further inquiries in connection with the above named
show that at the end of 19.8 Otto Kruger resided at 480
Muirhead Road. For some months afterwards he disappeared
but visited 475 Muirhead Road in June 1929 and has now been
located at 109 Rue Chapsal, French Concession. Otto Kruger
for some unknown reason does not always sleep at the latter
address and would appear to be a secretive individual as he
always goes about alone.
T. Medvedeff
P. S.
